scenes.title: The Album
scenes.headline: Chart climb
scenes.supportingCopy: The song appears on the album "Live In Texas" (2003). "Faint" is a song by American rock band Linkin Park from their second studio album, Meteora. The song was released as the album's second single on June 9, 2003, and is the seventh track. Live in Texas is the debut live album and the second DVD by American rock band Linkin Park, released on November 18, 2003, through Warner Records. The band's main setlist includes songs from their studio albums Hybrid Theory and Meteora, as well as one song from their remix album Reanimation. The live album peaked at #23 on the Billboard 200, and it has sold 1.1 million copies in the United States. Artist: Linkin Park · Title: Faint · Album: From The "Live In Texas" Album · Year: 2003 · Genre: Rock · Path: MEDIA/VIDEO/2000's/Linkin Park - Hybrid Theory is the debut studio album by American rock band Linkin Park, released on October 24, 2000, by Warner Bros. Recorded at NRG Recordings in North Hollywood, California, and produced by Don Gilmore, the album's lyrical themes deal with problems lead vocalist Chester Bennington experienced during his adolescence, including drug abuse and the constant fighting and eventual divorce of his parents.
